reason: blend:1 sets the eyes image blend mode (setBlendMode) and survives only because AvatarModule.test.ts fully mocks renderAvatarStack; a real render test asserting setBlendMode(1) would catch 1->2.

HIDE calls setVisible(false) to hide eyes; the only ran test (DisplayDefinitionCatalog) mocks CaveEyesModule entirely, so flipping to setVisible(true) survives but a tick test asserting hidden eyes would catch it.
Changing + to - flips the base-octave phase and shifts every contour coordinate, but the suite only checks point count/area, so no test pins the changed positions.
phaseFor's seed*(index+1) -> seed/(index+1) changes the phase for every index>0, altering contour and wedge geometry that no test pins by value.
Returning undefined instead of [] for radius<=0.5 is reachable (small radius) and breaks consumers, but all tests use radius=40 so the guard body never runs.
angle*frequency -> angle/frequency changes the pulse octave offset and thus contour points whenever pulseValue!=0, which existing tests never assert by value.
Changing the pulseOffset reduce seed from 0 to 1 shifts every contour length by pulseValue*1, observable at pulseValue!=0 but not pinned by the count/inequality/area tests.
+ to - in the tremor sine phase flips/shifts the tremor and thus wedge point offsets (even at timeMs=0 it negates the phase), which no test pins by value.

pulseValue*pulseLengthScale -> pulseValue/pulseLengthScale changes effectiveLength at pulse=1 from ~19.5 to ~88.7; the test only asserts hairs1>hairs0 which still holds, so the wrong magnitude survives.
rootWidthPx/2 -> rootWidthPx*2 quadruples the root half-width and shifts the wedge base points; the area>0.01 check still passes so the width change is unpinned.
sin(angle)*length -> sin(angle)/length collapses every contour y-coordinate, drastically changing geometry that the count/inequality/area tests never pin by value.
finalAngle - curlAngle -> + curlAngle shifts midAngle by ~2*0.054 rad, moving the wedge midpoint; no test pins midpoint coordinates so it survives area>0.01.
Forcing the radius<=0.5 guard to false makes tiny-radius inputs emit a full contour instead of []; reachable via small radius, but all tests use radius=40 where the guard was already false.
Dividing the mid half-width by 3 instead of 2 changes midPerp magnitude and the wedge midpoint, which survives the area>0.01 check because area stays positive.
Disabling the shape==="unhappy" branch makes it fall through to return 0.88 instead of 0.78; "unhappy" is a valid eyeShape and eyeHeight would differ, but no test exercises this file.
!== -> === inverts the resync guard so the rope never syncs on first render (lastSignature null != signature); both ran tests mock CycleProgressModule, so the real tick is never exercised.
radiusFactor returning undefined for the circle family yields NaN radii and NaN points; reachable for family circle but this file has no covering test.
Changing the base wobble harmonic from sin(3*angle) to sin(4*angle) alters every rope point position; the geometry has no covering test.
triangle lobes 3 -> 4 draws a square instead of a triangle, changing polygonFactor and point positions; reachable for family triangle but uncovered.
Pulse harmonic sin(4*angle) -> sin(5*angle) changes rope points whenever pulseValue!=0; reachable with a non-zero pulse but the file is uncovered.
Returning undefined instead of [] when findTopPathStart is null makes callers throw on .length; reachable via <2 points but the path module is uncovered.
remaining/closing -> remaining*closing turns an interpolation fraction into a large value, placing the closing point far off the segment; reachable for partial closing but uncovered.
Returning undefined instead of the built path makes the caller throw on points.length; reachable when the loop consumes all vertices before closing, but the file is uncovered.
return hideCycleProgressRope(rope) -> return undefined skips hiding the rope when points<2, leaving it visible; reachable but uncovered, a test asserting the rope hidden would catch it.
Forcing !body to false skips hideHalos and calls resolveHealthRatio on a null body (throws); DistressModule.test.ts only ticks with a body present, never the missing-body path.
DEFAULT_CYCLE_LIGHT alpha 1 -> 2 changes the returned light intensity for non-producer cycle entities; reachable and a resolveBaseLightState alpha assertion would catch it (this file is uncovered).
resolveCycleLightScale returning undefined makes resolveBaseLightState return null (undefined==null) instead of a light state, changing observable output for valid cycles; uncovered here.
heat producer light alpha 1 -> 2 changes the emitted light intensity for heat resources; reachable (resource===heat) and observable via alpha, but this file is uncovered.
parseRgb green radix 16 -> 17 changes the parsed green byte whenever its high nibble is non-zero (e.g. 45 -> 4*17+5); ran tests only call resolveLightState which never invokes parseRgb.
pointerX - nodeX -> pointerX + nodeX changes the proximity distance for any nodeX!=0, altering alpha and the cutoff result; reachable but this file is uncovered.
